title: Four things to know before you schedule.
kit: Block 1 · before you schedule
Four things to know before you schedule.
It writes on a timer. Moving work between people needs a flow.
Question
Answer
License
Microsoft 365 Copilot only. Copilot Chat without the license has no Schedule option.
How many
Up to 10 scheduled prompts per person. Edit, pause or delete them in Scheduled prompts.
Who sees it
Only you. The answer waits in your Copilot chats; nobody else gets it.
What it does
It writes an answer from what you can already see. It does not send, route or approve.

title: Before you build one, ask four questions.
kit: Block 3 · what a flow needs
Before you build one, ask four questions.
Ask your IT team first. Then build small.
License: does your Microsoft 365 account include Power Automate, and AI steps?
Permission: does your IT team allow these connectors?
Owner: who fixes it when it breaks, or when someone leaves?
People: is every decision still made by a person, and does a person check what the AI step writes?

title: Why not Copilot or an agent?
kit: Block 3 · why a flow here
Why not Copilot or an agent?
A flow moves work between people. It never replaces their decisions.
It starts on its own when a form, an email or a date arrives. A scheduled prompt runs on a timer too, but it only writes an answer for you.
It waits for an approval, for days if needed, then continues.
It logs and sends the same way every time: the row, the email, the draft.
Its AI step drafts and scores. A person reviews and decides.
